verdict.rationale: Tilled documents an API that partners call with API keys. The evidence shows it covers payment intents, closing batches, disputes (DisputesAPI) and webhooks (WebhooksAPI), so the core of driving the product programmatically is there. However, the evidence never shows a complete API reference, and several workflows (pricing templates, payout speed, merchant onboarding) are documented only as Dashboard steps, so full API coverage is unproven. missing for 10: a published API reference showing endpoint coverage across all product areas, documented API paths for pricing templates, payouts and merchant onboarding, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
